subject: Integration sprint slipped — request for trial extension & sandbox credits
messages:
From: Asha Menon <asha@metrolytics.ai>
To: michael_grant@redwood.ai
Date: Wed, 28 Apr 2027 16:12:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Metrolytics POC timeline — run into SSO/connector issues

Hi Michael,

Quick note from our side — our engineering sprint that was supposed to wire the streaming connector into our pipeline slipped by two weeks after we hit an SSO token refresh bug and an unexpected behavior in the Postgres CDC table schema. We pulled logs and attached a short trace (sso-trace.pdf) and an export of the connector errors (connector-error-log.zip).

We still believe Redwood is the right fit, but the delay has pushed our demo window into late May. Given that, can you help with: 
- A 30-day trial extension on our sandbox environment
- A small allocation of additional sandbox credits (~$2k) so our developers can finish the integration and run load tests

I can share a short mutual action plan if that helps — would like to keep momentum. Appreciate any runway to avoid starting the procurement conversation from scratch.

Thanks,
Asha Menon
Lead Engineer, Metrolytics
asha@metrolytics.ai
+1 (415) 555-0134

---
Attachment stubs: sso-trace.pdf (PDF, 180KB), connector-error-log.zip (ZIP, 2.1MB)

Hi Asha — thanks for the detail and the logs. Sorry to hear about the blocker.

Ill review the traces and loop in the team to see what we can do for credits and an extension. Can you share a one-page MAP (mutual action plan) with the critical milestones youre targeting for the next 4 weeks? If you have dates for the next demo window that helps us justify the extension internally.

Im looping in Marissa (AE) and Ben (Sales Ops) to surface the request, and Markus from SE for any quick triage on the SSO issue.

Ill aim to come back with a proposal within 48 hours.

Best,
Michael Grant
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
